row.team_price_text: USD 136 per user per month (contract 3 to 36 months)
row.evidence: SAP Sales Cloud has one listed plan (monthly price USD 136, in blocks of 1 user), and SAP's release note says the SCIM API for user management "is now enabled by default in the system" for SAP Sales Cloud Version 2.
row.notes: Single paid plan: SAP Sales Cloud is listed at a monthly price of USD 136 per user (contract 3 to 36 months; 'price upon request' also appears for structure and duration details), with paid service and field-sales add-ons; SCIM is enabled by default, so no SCIM upcharge. Facts are for SAP Sales Cloud Version 2 (shared with SAP Service Cloud V2). The SCIM API provisions Users and User Groups (groups map 1:1 to business roles); a Delete sets the user to Obsolete rather than deleting; auth is Basic, certificate or bearer token with a technical API user. SAP documents SAP Cloud Identity Services (IAS/IPS) as the intended client. The Okta OIN and Entra gallery apps are for the older SAP Cloud for Customer (SSO only; Entra says provisioning there is manual). Price is the monthly figure shown; annual billing is not separately listed.

plans.name: SAP Sales Cloud
plans.price_text: Monthly price USD 136.00, in blocks of 1 user, contract 3 to 36 months
plans.notes: Only plan on the pricing page; add-ons: service add-on USD 22 and field sales add-on USD 53 per user per month. SCIM comes from the release note that it is enabled by default.

scim.notes: SAP describes the API as based on the SCIM specification without naming a version. Endpoint paths are on SAP Business Accelerator Hub (SalesSvcCloudV2_scimUserService / scimGroupService), which could not be loaded.

auth.token_source: Technical (API) user created under System Settings > Users and Control > Users with a technical admin role
auth.notes: Basic Authentication, Certificate Authentication or Bearer Token Authentication.

deprovision.data_retained: No hard or soft delete; a Delete request sets the user status to Obsolete, and a later Create for that user reactivates it with the same ID.

attributes.notes: The help page names User Type, Valid From, Valid To, Login Name and Employee Number as fields to verify after setup; the full attribute schema is on SAP Business Accelerator Hub, which could not be loaded.

roles.how: Each SCIM group maps 1:1 to a business role; creating a group with a new display name creates a role.

limitations.text: SCIM data is treated as master data and overwrites user attributes maintained in the system.
SCIM applies to business users, not integration users created through communication systems.
No monitoring tools are provided for direct SCIM API use.

okta.notes: OIN app is for SAP Cloud for Customer (the earlier Sales Cloud); only SAML is checked (read from page markup). No OIN app found for Sales Cloud Version 2 (okta.com/integrations/sap-sales-cloud/ 404).

entra.notes: Entra gallery app is SAP Cloud for Customer with SP-initiated SSO; Microsoft says provisioning there is manual.

fallbacks.other_sync: SAP Cloud Identity Services Identity Provisioning (IPS) with IAS as source is the documented integration; local user maintenance in the system is also possible.
